# Recorded RGB discovery inputs

These two authored CC0 PNGs and factual CPU outputs reuse the two previously
recorded complete texture-wrapper input calls. No new native call was performed
while adding the implementation. The JSON pins source hashes and physical
format22 descriptors. Its RGBA values project original RGB and the format22
reader's defined alpha255. Native raw X differs between the POT copy and NPOT
packer; X is excluded from this sampled-pixel record and product digests.

These are calibration/discovery inputs, not independent holdouts, World tests or
GPU results. Normal tests need no EXE, private data or research runner. Source
names and gamma values are never used as a product whitelist. The original RGBA
calibration and its independent holdouts retain their separate provenance.

`holdout.json` separately records one independently authorized LaserMain02 input
call after the RGB implementation was frozen. It reuses the existing public CC0
PNG instead of duplicating input or a large RGBA table. The zero-tolerance hash
covers49152 original RGB bytes. Its16384 alpha255 components are the already
proved static format22 sampling rule, with no native alpha or GPU observation.
Unused backing X remains only in local raw research evidence. Ordinary tests
require neither that evidence nor the executable/runner.
